record.original_question: Let X be a projective manifold with large algebraic fundamental group and let L be an ample line bundle on X. Given a positive number N, does there exist a finite étale cover p: X'→X such that either (1) the Seshadri number of p^*L at every point of X' is greater than N, or (2) the Seshadri number of p_e^*(p_1^*L \otimes p_2^*L) along the diagonal in X'	imes X' is greater than N? If not in general, what condition on the fundamental group of X guarantees such a positive answer?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth complex projective variety, and let $L$ be an ample line bundle on $X$. Recall that the Seshadri constant of $L$ at a point $x \in X$ is
$$\varepsilon(L;x) = \inf_{C \ni x} \frac{L \cdot C}{\mathrm{mult}_x C},$$
where the infimum is over irreducible curves $C \subset X$ passing through $x$. For a closed subvariety $D \subset X$, the Seshadri constant of $L$ along $D$ is defined analogously using multiplicity along $D$. Say that $X$ has large algebraic fundamental group if for every positive-dimensional closed irreducible subvariety $Z \subset X$ with normalization $\tilde Z \to Z$, the image of $\pi_1^{\mathrm{alg}}(\tilde Z) \to \pi_1^{\mathrm{alg}}(X)$ is infinite.

Assume $X$ has large algebraic fundamental group, and fix a real number $N > 0$. Let $p_1, p_2 : X \times X \to X$ be the two projections, and for a finite étale cover $p_e : Y \to X \times X$ let $\Delta_Y \subset Y$ denote the preimage of the diagonal $\Delta \subset X \times X$.

(1) Does there exist a finite étale cover $p : X' \to X$ such that $\varepsilon(p^*L; x') > N$ for every $x' \in X'$?

(2) Does there exist a finite étale cover $p_e : Y \to X \times X$ such that the Seshadri constant of $p_e^*(p_1^*L \otimes p_2^*L)$ along $\Delta_Y$ is greater than $N$?

(3) If neither (1) nor (2) holds in this generality, identify a condition on $\pi_1(X)$ (e.g.\ residual finiteness) that guarantees an affirmative answer.
artifact.status_search_result: Part (1) of the problem (originally a conjecture of J.-M. Hwang) was answered affirmatively by G. and L. F. Di Cerbo (arXiv:1411.1033, 2014): if $X$ has large algebraic fundamental group and $L$ is ample, then for any $N>0$ there is a finite étale cover $p:X'\to X$ with $\varepsilon(p^*L;x)\geq N$ at every point. They also proved an analogous statement for big and nef $L$ assuming $\pi_1(X)$ is large and residually finite. The diagonal version (2) and the precise optimal hypothesis on $\pi_1(X)$ in (3) do not appear to have been completely settled.

status_evidence.title: On Seshadri constants of varieties with large fundamental group
status_evidence.snippet: Given a smooth complex projective variety X with large algebraic fundamental group and an ample line bundle L on X, we show that the Seshadri constant ε(p*L) can be made arbitrarily large by passing to a finite étale cover p:X'→X. This result answers affirmatively a conjecture of J.-M. Hwang.
status_evidence.claim: Part (1) is solved affirmatively for ample L on smooth projective X with large algebraic fundamental group; an extension to big and nef L holds under residual finiteness.
